- Invalid input has an associated alert and aria-invalid

### Compatibility

Billable amount is an integer number of minor units. Decimal major-unit edits emit number \| undefined, rounded half up with decimal arithmetic; zero is valid, blank emits undefined, and negatives or unsafe values retain the draft and emit no update. amountField/currencyField bind runtime amount/currency; minorUnitsParameter resolves to the declared object parameter. Uncontrolled text is retained until amount/minorUnits changes. HTML supplies the same static value and validation semantics; framework components own updates.
